prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (UV beds vs spray, budget, neighborhood). I can look up highly rated salons near you if you tell me your ZIP code or Columbus neighborhood and whether you want spray/tanning beds/airbrush. 

Meanwhile, how to pick the best one:
- Type: decide on spray (sunless) or UV (tanning beds). Spray is safer than UV exposure.
- Reviews: check Google Maps and Yelp for 4+ star places with many recent reviews.
- Cleanliness & maintenance: fresh bulbs, clean booths, working ventilation — ask when bulbs were last changed.
- Staff & training: technicians who do patch tests and help pick a solution/bed time are preferable.
- Options: multiple spray solution shades, stand-up spray booths, different bed levels if you use UV.
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions vs membership; watch for long contracts.
- Safety practices: they should offer protective eyewear, advise session length by skin type, and recommend limits between sessions.

Red flags:
- No staff or training, poor hygiene, overly aggressive upselling, no protective eyewear offered, or very old equipment.

If you give your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll pull the top 3–5 salons in Columbus with ratings, addresses, and pros/cons. I can also include hours and directions.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
